turns.assessment: The svc207 working path traverses S08, and the large outage at t=684.3 affects services using many different optical degrees but sharing transit through S08. Optical power, OSNR, BER, DGD, and amplifier telemetry remained unchanged, strongly excluding fibre, amplifier, WSS-channel, and line-interface faults. The earlier CARD_FAIL at trx.och24.a explains a separate S06–S21 event and is not on svc207's path. The evidence therefore identifies an S08 OTN switch-fabric failure.

proposals.rationale: An OTN switch failure at S08 interrupts every ODU cross-connected there, matching the simultaneous failure of the many services whose paths transit S08. Services avoiding S08 remain operational, while unchanged optical telemetry across the involved spans and channels rules against an optical-layer loss.
